title: 2023 Panini Select Club Level Silver Die-Cut #244 Kendre Miller (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Select sports trading card featuring rookie player Kendre Miller from the New Orleans Saints. The card is a Club Level Silver Die-Cut parallel variety, card number 244 in the set. It is not autographed and is part of the National Football League (NFL) league season.
